# Aethereal Device Service

A **modified [OpenRGB](https://gitlab.com/CalcProgrammer1/OpenRGB)**, stripped down to a background service: OpenRGB's
device drivers and its SDK server, with no window and no Qt. The [Aethereal](https://github.com/ZPenguinMaster)
PC app uses it to drive keyboards, mice, headsets, fans, RAM, motherboards and other brands' lights, talking to it over
the OpenRGB SDK on the same PC.

This isn't OpenRGB and isn't supported by the OpenRGB project; the device support is all their work. For OpenRGB
itself, go to [openrgb.org](https://openrgb.org).

- **What's changed from OpenRGB, how to build and run it:** [AETHEREAL.md](../AETHEREAL.md)
- **Licence:** GPL-2.0-or-later ([LICENSE](../LICENSE)). Every release's exact source is at its tag and attached to
  the release.
- **OpenRGB's own readme:** [README.md](../README.md)
